annotations.title: Read check results for a proposal

description: Read the check runs and commit statuses GitHub reports for a proposal's pull request head commit (cached for 60 s). state is retrieved, required_pending, required_failed or required_passed; validated is true only when the required checks passed on the exact commit the room created. task_evidence can be passed as the evidence of a room task result.

proposal.description: The proposal id, or its room number (3 for P3).

room_credential.description: Your secret room credential (crc_…). Never post or share it.
